purpose: Define placement of a MetaModule into nanoCMS site/page/route structure as an explicit presentation binding while nanoCMS owns structure and the MetaModule owns its own composition semantics.

topics.name: MetaModule nanoCMS Placement Boundary
topics.purpose: Define placement of a MetaModule into nanoCMS site/page/route structure as an explicit presentation binding while nanoCMS owns structure and the MetaModule owns its own composition semantics.

semantics.placement_rule: Placement references exact MetaModule and exact nanoCMS site/page/location identity.
semantics.ownership_rule: nanoCMS owns site hierarchy/routes/navigation/placement metadata; MetaModule owns application/composition semantics.
semantics.multi_rule: One MetaModule definition may be placed multiple times without semantic duplication.
semantics.route_rule: Route/placement identity never replaces MetaModule identity.
semantics.self_host_rule: Expose Editor may be placed as an ordinary MetaModule under nanoCMS with no privileged class.
semantics.removal_rule: Removing placement removes visibility/binding, not the underlying MetaModule definition.

invariants.rule: A MetaModule is an explicit composition of existing semantic capabilities; composition, placement or runtime activation never silently transfers ownership, identity or authority from constituent modules/resources.

hard_gates.condition: nanoCMS becomes owner of MetaModule semantics

references.purpose: Editor is an ordinary self-hosted MetaModule.

prose.summary: Define placement of a MetaModule into nanoCMS site/page/route structure as an explicit presentation binding while nanoCMS owns structure and the MetaModule owns its own composition semantics.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against composition, nanoCMS, UserModule, Editor and runtime activation contracts.
